data.title: Asian Exchanges Race to Capture Shift in Global Capital Jet Stream
data.description: As multi-trillion-dollar indices freeze new allocations to the US, Asian bourses deploy radical listings and governance reforms to capture the historic spillover of global wealth

data.title: Asia-Pacific finance shifts from AI spending to measurable value
data.description: Asia-Pacific banks are shifting from AI experiments to measurable returns as real-time finance grows, but skills shortages remain a critical barrier.

data.title: Retail giants turn mall revamps into Bangkok’s new property battleground
data.description: Thailand’s leading retail and property groups are investing billions of baht in mall revamps and mixed-use projects, turning ageing shopping centres into lifestyle, cultural and food landmarks as mass transit and rising land values reshape Bangkok’s key districts.

data.title: RESAM calls for new city plan to end mandatory parking for condos near rail stations
data.description: RESAM says scrapping compulsory parking requirements for condominiums near electric train stations could cut urban housing prices, encourage mass-transit use and support more affordable city living.

data.title: Top 5 rail-line land price rises revealed, Green Line Khu Khot-Lam Luk Ka leads
data.description: REIC data shows land prices along mass transit routes continued to climb in the second quarter of 2026, led by the Green Line extension from Khu Khot to Lam Luk Ka.
